name: rotation
description: Machine-governed session rotation for long autonomous runs: a trigger gate (TRIG-1..8) that releases a handover only on measured work, a turn-end invariant gate, a rules-table close planner with verdicts, interruption recovery and a watchdog, all driven by append-only jsonl state; lanes run a second executor on its own branch beside the first. The kernel knows no project; a project adapts it through project.sh, rotation.conf and four adapter commands. The hardev command runs every kernel operation as `hardev <noun> <verb>`.
